tools.description: Guarded commit with explicit paths and message. Commit messages require a subject, a blank second line, and at least one '- ' verification bullet. A commit scope with more than 8 paths requires riskAck:true.

cwd.description: Absolute WC directory; required for relative paths.

operation.description: commit (default), prepare, safe end-to-end commit, or paged safe-operation detail.

message.description: Required for commit/safe; ignored for prepare/detail. Commit messages require a subject, a blank second line, and at least one '- ' verification bullet.

riskAck.description: Set riskAck:true when more than 8 paths are in the commit scope or another G6 signal is present.

allowDirectoryTargets.description: Acknowledge that an existing directory target commits only the directory node; descendants require explicit paths.

expandDescendants.description: Expand explicit directory targets to all currently changed descendants, guard every result, and expose the exact scope.
